crossRefs.note: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has…
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope…

translations.web: I teach you today, even you, So that your trust may be in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I instruct you today—yes, you.
translations.kjv: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day,
translations.asv: That thy trust may be in Jehovah, I have made them known to thee this day, even to thee.
